_note: New 150-card project's keyword set. The old Rush/Growth/Frenzy keywords from the previous Faction Clash card set are paused, not carried over -- note the OLD 'Growth' below is unrelated to the NEW 'Growth' keyword added 2026-08-17 for the Verdant Circle set (verdant_cards_batch1.json); the new one is a deliberate, differently-defined reintroduction of the name, not a revival of the old mechanic. Old Rush/Frenzy remain fully retired.

Invoke.description: Triggers immediately when this card is played (functionally equivalent to a battlecry).

Start of Turn.description: Triggers at the start of your turn.

Berserk.description: Triggers the first time this unit takes damage.

Echo.description: Triggers when another friendly unit is destroyed.

Growth.description: If this unit took no damage since its last Growth check, its Growth effect triggers at the start of your turn.
Growth._note: Growth is Verdant's self-only delayed trigger. At the start of its controller's turn, a Growth unit checks whether it took damage since its previous check; if it did not, only that unit resolves its printed Growth effect. The damage gate creates counterplay without turning every Growth effect into a multi-unit aura. Any card that should affect adjacent units must say so explicitly in its rules text and is balanced as a separate positional effect.
